_note: Required application documents the bot can auto-attach. Fields: file (relative to project root), doc_type (Handshake documentTypeId NAME: resume=1, cover=2, transcript=3, other='Other Document'=5), name (the /docs name to upload/find it under; defaults to the picker_query), section_regex (modal header that signals the requirement), picker_query (text typed into the react-select), match (option text to click; defaults to picker_query — used to disambiguate same-content docs of different types), instruction_keywords (substrings matched, typo-tolerant, against the employer's free-text note in a generic 'Attach other required documents' section; only entries with doc_type='other' are eligible there, since Handshake requires that section's doc to be typed 'Other Document'), auto_attach. Add entries here as new required uploads appear.
